visual.name: rangeSlicer
visual.description: Numeric range slicer and range filter with the histogram behind the slider: drag, draw a range on the bars or type exact values, pick quartiles, top or bottom 10% or no outliers, and see what the range keeps. Filter customers or products by a measure per entity. Premium: live rules (top 10%, ±1σ, P5–P95), several ranges, exclude bands and named buckets, a second field, the distribution split by segment or against last year, and the top entities the range dropped. Part of the SmartVisuals family for Power BI.
